# axiz-adapter-messaging-sns

Amazon SNS publisher adapter (standard and FIFO).

## Dependency

```xml
<dependency>
  <groupId>pe.axiz</groupId>
  <artifactId>axiz-adapter-messaging-sns</artifactId>
</dependency>
```

The version is managed by `axiz-bom` (services inherit `axiz-parent-service`).

## Main types

| Type | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `SnsEventPublisher` | Publishes CloudEvents (structured JSON) to Amazon SNS topics (fan-out). |

## Native publication

`SnsAsyncEventPublisher` uses the SDK asynchronous client, sharing request construction with the imperative
adapter. Successful completion is the broker acknowledgement. Cancellation reaches the exact SDK
future; submission errors are returned as failed stages, and cancellation/fatal failures preserve
their meaning. FIFO group and deduplication identities remain unchanged.

## Tests

Unit tests live in `src/test/java` and document the expected behavior; run them with `./mvnw -pl adapters/axiz-adapter-messaging-sns verify`.
